description: Implement an automatic self-healing system that detects and recovers tasks that appear stuck (marked as running but no active process). The system runs as a background monitoring service that checks all tasks every 10 seconds and automatically restarts stuck tasks with rate limiting (max 3 restarts per 3 minutes per task).

subtasks.title: Implement grace period check
subtasks.description:
Implement isWithinGracePeriod(task) method:
- Check if task.statusUpdatedAt is within GRACE_PERIOD_MS (2 seconds) of current time
- Return true if within grace period (should skip recovery)
- Return false if grace period has passed or timestamp missing
acceptanceCriteria: Returns true for tasks with status changed within 2 seconds
Returns false for tasks with status changed more than 2 seconds ago
Handles missing timestamp gracefully (returns false)
subtasks.notes: The isWithinGracePeriod(task) method was already fully implemented in subtask 1.1. Verified implementation at lines 133-145 of task-monitor.ts: 1) Returns false if task.updatedAt is missing (handles missing timestamp gracefully), 2) Converts Date to timestamp properly handling both Date objects and strings, 3) Returns true if timeSinceUpdate < GRACE_PERIOD_MS (2000ms), 4) Returns false if grace period has passed. All acceptance criteria met. Note: The Task type uses 'updatedAt' not 'statusUpdatedAt' - updatedAt is updated whenever task changes including status changes.

subtasks.title: Implement checkAllTasks monitoring loop
subtasks.description:
Implement the private async checkAllTasks() method:
- Return early if projectStore or agentManager is null
- Get all projects from projectStore.getAllProjects()
- For each project, iterate through project.tasks
- Filter for tasks with status 'in_progress' or 'ai_review'
- Skip if agentManager.isRunning(task.id) returns true
- Skip if isWithinGracePeriod(task) returns true
- Skip if isRecovering.get(task.id) is true
- For stuck tasks: log detection, cleanup old attempts, check rate limit
- If under rate limit: set isRecovering, call recoverStuckTaskInternal, record attempt, clear isRecovering

Skips tasks that are actually running
Skips tasks within grace period
Skips tasks already being recovered

Calls recoverStuckTaskInternal for stuck tasks under rate limit
